summary: Quote now computes each line exactly in integers (cents*qty*(100-pct)) and rounds half to even (r<50 down, r>50 up, r==50 to even q), replacing float64+math.Round which rounded halves away from zero. A hand byte parser replicates TrimSpace/Cut/Atoi ranges (sign, ASCII/unicode spaces, first ; and :, 1..NumDocs/1..99, Fold-matched codes incl. accented/fullwidth spellings), so ignored items, code matching, and every non-half-cent cart total are unchanged. No shared mutable state (precomputed folded codes), safe for concurrent use, stdlib only. Bench: 193->106 ns/op (-44.9%), allocs 1->0; pricing own time per visit falls, so entry mean latency should drop.
